claim: P1 engineering natural-route non-inferiority for bounded verified atomic local model-artifact transfer and interrupted HTTP Range resume against source-pinned libcurl 8.22.0 through its public easy API

configuration.route: public curl_easy file and HTTP APIs with benchmark-owned checksum, source-identity, temporary-file, sync and atomic-publication adapters
configuration.progress: one caller-owned easy handle per attempt; global curl state, source fixture and loopback server remain outside timing
configuration.protocols: ordinary FILE and identity-encoded HTTP/1.1 routes from the unmodified release source tree

ownership_topology.candidate: One persistent HYLE Scheduler/IoContext remains outside timing; each episode constructs one owning TransferPlan, one verifier and one joined transfer task, then retires all attempt state
ownership_topology.peer: One persistent curl global context remains outside timing; each episode constructs one easy handle and benchmark-owned verifier/file adapter, then retires all attempt state
ownership_topology.equivalence: Both open and validate the same source, transfer exactly 256 MiB through a requested 1 MiB bounded block, verify every byte, recheck source identity, sync and close a sibling temporary file, and atomically replace an existing destination

material_contribution.derivation: Inference startup and cache preparation commonly stage one complete local model artifact before making it visible to loaders

workloads.semantic_contract: Copy one sparse 256 MiB regular model artifact to a sibling temporary file with O(1) memory, incremental FNV-1a verification, before/after source-identity validation, file data-and-metadata sync, close and atomic replacement of an existing destination

input.distribution: one fixed zero-filled sparse regular file with a precomputed deterministic digest

workloads.setup: Create and sync the sparse source and old destinations, compute the expected digest and construct persistent runtimes before timing; complete one route-ordered warmup episode
charged_phases: per-attempt plan or easy-handle and bounded adapter construction
source open and initial metadata validation
complete source reads, incremental FNV-1a verification and positioned temporary-file writes
atomic replacement of an existing sibling destination and attempt teardown

ownership_topology.candidate: The persistent HYLE runtime owns one interrupted plan/checkpoint and a resumed plan; one external caller joins both attempts before retiring the report state
ownership_topology.peer: The persistent curl global context owns two sequential easy handles while one benchmark adapter retains the sibling partial and exact offset between attempts
ownership_topology.equivalence: Both fetch the same 64 MiB identity representation, stop after reaching the 32 MiB threshold, retain the partial, open a new connection with Range plus If-Range, validate 206, ETag, Content-Range and complete extent, sync and atomically publish; both download exactly one artifact in total

material_contribution.denominator: one interrupted and resumed model download
material_contribution.derivation: Large model downloads are routinely interrupted; a valid retained prefix must avoid a second full download without weakening publication safety

workloads.semantic_contract: Fetch one 64 MiB loopback HTTP/1 representation, intentionally interrupt at the first completed body progress point at or beyond 32 MiB, retain the sibling partial and strong ETag, then resume from the exact retained offset through Range and If-Range, validate the 206 extent and atomically publish after sync

input.distribution: one deterministic identity-encoded zero body with a fixed strong ETag served on loopback HTTP/1.1

workloads.setup: Construct the loopback Range server, old destinations and persistent runtimes before timing; complete one route-ordered interrupted-plus-resumed warmup episode
charged_phases: initial HTTP GET, response validation and bounded temporary-file writes
intentional cancellation after reaching the threshold plus partial retention
second connection with Range and If-Range
bounded suffix transfer from the retained offset
temporary-file sync and close, atomic replacement and attempt teardown
